Spatial description of; its relation to ईश्वर and other creations.
4: वा. ४९. १५६-86.

--Evolution of Tattvas, etc. When the शक्तिस् did not attend to their function of creation, the Lord with शक्तिकाला entered into twenty-three तत्त्वस् by dividing him- self into three parts--अध्यात्म, आधिदैव, and आधिभौम with tenfold प्राण, Agni as his mouth, वरुण as tongue, अश्विन्स् as nostrils, etc. Then came the four वर्णस्। At first five varieties of अज्ञान were created, viz., अन्धतामिस्र, तामिस्र, महामोह, moha, and tamas. Ashamed of these sinful creations, ब्रह्मा created seers like Sanaka, Sananda, etc. They also did not proceed with the work of creation as was desired. So ब्रह्मा grew angry and down came Rudra from the midst of his eye-brows. He was assigned places and women. Finding his creation intolerable, ब्रह्मा sent him away for penance, and produced ten mind-born sons, मरिची, Atri and others, and a daughter सरस्वती. Then came the Vedas and other literature. Further the Creator's body got into two halves--one स्वायम्भुव and the other शतरूप. These were parents of two sons and three daughters. Their descendants filled up the whole of the earth. Another account of creation. भा.

.
